evidence.location: frontmatter gates and evidence blocks; body paragraph beginning 'Focused result'
evidence.observation: Gates declare "pytest -q tests/test_consolidation_loop.py --tb=short" and "pytest -q tests/test_consolidation_loop.py tests/test_rf6_query_policy.py --tb=short" at "exit: 0", and evidence pins "path: tests/test_consolidation_loop.py" with "sha256: 8d6b728550efe0679efc7966008e9aaa9899c2cc468642659a4edea3ab3c3580". The body states: "Focused result: 16 passed in 10.13s. The post-repair focused and RF6 checks returned 32 passed in 17.73s before the directory-alias regression was added." Both verbatim summaries are therefore recorded as captured before the final test was added to the very file whose digest is pinned, so no receipt in the artifact corresponds to the pinned bytes.
"Run the first spec's focused selection and retain its verbatim pytest summary."

concerns.recommendation: Re-run both pytest gates against the pinned tests/test_consolidation_loop.py bytes (sha256 8d6b7285...) and replace the two stale counts with the verbatim summary lines from those runs, noting the digest they were produced against.
concerns.title: Recorded gate summaries predate the pinned test file, so gate exit 0 is unevidenced

evidence.observation: "It compares the complete model bytes, all durable decision fields (including IDs and work counters), and the resulting report and terminal reason." The artifact reports that a comparison happens but contains no model digest, no counter value, no decision identity, no surviving-reference listing and no terminal-reason string anywhere in its 2057 bytes.

"Compare the final model digest, surviving references, located evidence, decision identities, counters and terminal reason between uninterrupted and resumed runs. ... Put the replay and exact results in the milestone close record."

concerns.recommendation: Add the exact compared values for the uninterrupted and resumed runs (final model digest, work-counter and decision counts, decision IDs, terminal reason text, surviving reference set) to the closure evidence, or submit the milestone close record that carries them for review alongside this delta.
concerns.title: Closure evidence omits the exact replay results amendment 5 mandates

evidence.observation: "Changing the supporting source of a declined group offers it again." This is the only statement about declined groups; the artifact nowhere records that a declined group with unchanged evidence is not offered again after restart.
"CG3: accept one group, decline another, restart from the decision log and verify that the declined group is not offered again unless its evidence changes." and "test both sides of every refusal."

concerns.recommendation: Record the negative-side result explicitly: after restart from the decision log with unchanged evidence, the declined group is absent from the offered set (with the counter or terminal reason showing it was suppressed), paired with the existing re-offer result.
concerns.title: Only the permissive side of the declined-group restart criterion is reported

evidence.observation: "The reporter's two large models were unavailable." and "Local samples and source provenance establish the checks' scope." The artifact does not state which #338/#339 reproduction steps were executed against local fixtures, nor that any reproduction step was skipped.

"Issue requirements come from [#338]..., [#339]..., including their proposed changes and reproduction examples." and "For each later phase, use the issue reproduction and the criterion in §4 as an acceptance pair, pin the old behavior on unextended inputs and record the public entry point and result." Also: "Native backend claims require native execution."

concerns.recommendation: State per issue which reproduction steps were run and against what inputs, and record the owner ruling that treats the reporter's large-model corpus trial as optional rather than as the §9 acceptance pair; if any reproduction step was not run, list it as an unverified claim rather than a boundary.
concerns.title: Mandatory issue-reproduction acceptance pairs are not shown to have been executed

evidence.location: ## Independent review and refactoring; frontmatter evidence
evidence.observation: "One reviewer is one reviewer." The section cites a single review and ledger: "The [review](notes/reviews/CG3-r1/independent-review.md) found two group-scope issues..." and evidence pins only "tests/test_consolidation_loop.py" and ".gnd-planning/milestones/cross-document-growth/notes/reviews/CG3-r1/independent-review.md", while the body asserts "Delegated acceptance (auto=true) on November 28, 2026."
"Each phase needs its own spec and owner ruling, implementation, focused tests, independent diff review, refactoring review and numbered record."

concerns.recommendation: Either add the digest-bound refactoring review artifact for CG3 as a distinct seat, or record the owner's explicit waiver of the second seat in this station so the acceptance claim matches plan §8.
concerns.title: Plan §8 requires an independent diff review and a refactoring review; only one seat is evidenced

evidence.observation: "A pre-publication stale intent is superseded only before evidence staging." and "Divergence after staging requires reconciliation." No refusal, digest check or test is recorded for a proposal whose reviewed model digest no longer matches once staging has begun.

"Bind each decision to group and evidence hashes and the reviewed model digest." and "A mutation uses one digest-bound proposal for the entire group, including row moves and role rewrites." and "Check constraint conflicts and dangling references before applying."

concerns.recommendation: Record the digest-mismatch behavior after staging as an explicit refusal with a test result, or state that recovery completes the originally digest-bound proposal unchanged; do not leave the path to an undefined reconciliation step.
concerns.title: Stale-intent handling is bounded only 'before evidence staging', leaving post-staging divergence to unspecified reconciliation

evidence.observation: "The journal and model directory are locally trusted. The workflow needs POSIX directory locking for journal writers." The artifact records no implemented lock, no refusal when locking is unavailable, and no test for concurrent writers.

"Persist proposal and decision identity before publishing, and complete the existing transaction on recovery." and "Demonstrate failed rewrites leave both rows and references intact and restart after publication completes the ledger once."

concerns.recommendation: Either evidence the directory lock and a concurrent-writer or lock-unavailable refusal test, or record an owner ruling that single-writer operation is a documented precondition of the shipped skill so the residual is scoped rather than open.
concerns.title: Declared need for POSIX directory locking is an unmet precondition with no guard or ruling

evidence.observation: "A separately installed offline wheel ran the packaged terminal example and recorded one leave before reporting a different group. The wheel test preceded the final review repairs."
"CG3 owns the packaged consolidation skill and its installed example." and "Run existing examples and compare the observable result for a caller using the previous interface."

concerns.recommendation: Re-run the installed offline wheel example against the post-repair build and record its observable output next to the pre-repair result, so the packaged entry-point claim rests on shipped bytes.
concerns.title: Packaged terminal skill was only exercised on a wheel built before the final review repairs

evidence.observation: "The phase structure, CLI, packaging, install, doctor, disclosure and CG1–3 selection on the earlier implementation returned 1053 passed, 2 deselected in 170.41s." The artifact attributes the only broad regression number to "the earlier implementation" and offers no equivalent run against the final CG3 bytes.
"The product changed on the milestone branch."

concerns.recommendation: Either record a post-repair broad selection run with its verbatim summary, or label the 1053-passed figure as superseded so the closure ruling does not treat it as verification of the shipped code.
concerns.title: The only whole-suite count is explicitly attributed to a superseded implementation

evidence.observation: "...supplies bytes for a second document and appends an already-observed tuple from its distinct cited occurrence." and "A separate stale-input control, a deontic constraint conflict, and an incomplete transfer leave original model bytes intact." The artifact never records the refusal of a repeated identical tuple at an identical source occurrence, nor a separated differing-excerpt versus differing-document test.

"A repeated identical tuple and source occurrence adds no evidence and is refused as redundant. ... Test differing excerpts and differing documents separately." and "test both sides of every refusal."

concerns.recommendation: Add the redundant-occurrence refusal result and the two separated negative controls (differing excerpt, differing document) to the closure replay description, or point to the phase record that carries their verbatim results.
concerns.title: Closure replay evidences only the admitting side of the duplicate-observation rule

evidence.observation: "Issues #338 and #339 remain open pending merge into the default branch." This is the only mention of the two issues; the artifact maps no requirement of either issue to a phase result.
"Milestone closure requires a replay across phases, a disposition for each issue and an inventory of unverified claims."

concerns.recommendation: Add a short per-issue disposition (for #338 and #339 separately: which §4 exit criterion and which recorded result discharges it, and what remains unverified) so merge status is not the only statement about the issues.
concerns.title: Closure evidence states merge status but no disposition per issue as §9 requires

response.summary: The CG3 record and closure delta describe a coherent consolidation loop, an integrated two-document replay and an interruption/restart comparison, but the results as submitted do not yet demonstrate the mandatory criteria. The recorded pytest summaries are explicitly pre-dated relative to the pinned test bytes, the closure evidence narrates the uninterrupted/resumed comparison without reporting any of the compared values that plan amendment 5 requires, and only the admitting side of several both-sides refusals (declined-group suppression, redundant identical occurrence) is evidenced. Packaged-wheel and broad-suite results are attributed to pre-repair or earlier implementations, and post-staging divergence plus journal-writer locking remain declared residuals without a guard, test or owner ruling. No origin-loss or journal-recovery failure is asserted by the bytes; the defects are unsupported or stale demonstration claims rather than observed breakage.
